risk_if_not_implemented: Without Analyze Traffic for Covert Exfiltration, sensitive and/or regulated data may be exfiltrated, leaked or transferred outside authorized boundaries without detection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Analyze Traffic for Covert Exfiltration (MON-20.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect sensitive information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Analyze Traffic for Covert Exfiltration (MON-20.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
